summary: DigitalOcean Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 12,543,915 shares of common stock at $117.54 per share, against a last sale price of $119.65 (1.8% discount). The issuer receives approximately $1.474 billion in gross proceeds before expenses. J. Wood Capital Advisors acts as financial advisor. Shares are expected to settle on July 23, 2026 on a T+5 cycle, requiring purchasers to specify alternate settlement for trades before that date. This is a routine capital markets financing transaction, not a special situation; it does not involve a change of control, activist campaign, restructuring, or other event-driven scenario.
